# Your images go here

This is your upload folder. Put any photos you want on the website into this
folder: **`public/images/`**

Anything you place under `public/` is published as-is — in local preview **and**
on the live site — so you don't have to touch any code to add a picture.

## How to use it

1. Copy your photo files into `public/images/` (this folder).
2. Tell me the filename(s) and which page/section they should go on, and I'll
   place them into the design for you.

## Tips for good-looking photos

- Use plain filenames with no spaces: `clinic-team.jpg`, `waiting-room.jpg`
  (use hyphens instead of spaces).
- **Landscape** photos work best for wide feature areas.
- Aim for roughly **1200×900 px** or larger so they stay sharp on big screens.
- Keep each file **under ~500 KB** if you can (compress large photos) so pages
  load fast. Free tool: <https://squoosh.app>.
